release.versionName: 1.0.5.6 - Lyrics Preview and Score Customization (Build 15.10.4 DEV)
release.notes: DEV TEST ONLY — Build 15.10.4: early MIDI/KAR lyrics preview (MIDI markers still drive sync); custom score sound volume and MP3/WAV/OGG import; user-editable/randomized messages for five score brackets. Developer channel becomes manual-check-only with no auto reminders. Experimental owner QA build. Original scoring algorithm, Stable and Beta unchanged.
